description: Mayor Nicholson is running for re-election to continue the progress Gardner has made under his leadership. From opening the city’s first new elementary school in over 100 years to revitalizing downtown and expanding infrastructure, he’s delivered real results. A lifelong Gardner resident, Mike is committed to building on this momentum—boosting economic growth, improving education, and creating a brighter future for all.
title: Home | Mike Nicholson | Mayor of Gardner
